name: VESPER AESTHETICS Obsidian Vigil DualMode Eye
description:
The Obsidian Vigil is Vesper Aesthetics' open secret—a fashion ocular that presents as a luxury cosmetic product while housing a restricted-tier threat detection and low-light combat suite underneath its signature solid-black aesthetic. The outer display layer renders a seamless obsidian iris with optional subtle iridescent shimmer, indistinguishable from a high-end cosmetic implant; beneath it, a secondary processor runs passive threat-range estimation, motion prediction in peripheral vision, and full-spectrum low-light amplification invisible to external observers. Switching between fashion and tactical modes takes a practiced blink sequence.

Vesper markets the Vigil discreetly through private consultation, never in public catalogs, and the clientele list is understood to include Spire security-conscious executives, high-profile entertainers with genuine threat profiles, and a certain class of Tier 4 socialite who prefers to be underestimated. On the street they're called Pretty Killers by people who've learned the hard way that not all fashion eyes are harmless.
installation_requirements: Vesper private clinic only; appointment-based; identity verification required; 3.5-hour procedure
rejection_risk: Low — Vesper premium biocompatible housing; dual-processor thermal load requires 8-week thermal regulation adaptation period
maintenance: Annual Vesper private clinic service; fashion layer substrate recharge every 18 months; tactical firmware updates via secure Vesper channel
specifications: {"fashion_layer": "full-sclera obsidian display with optional iridescent shimmer, 8 intensity settings", "low_light_amplification": "full spectrum to 0.001 lux", "threat_ranging": "passive optical range estimation to 200m", "motion_prediction": "peripheral motion arc modeling, 160° field", "mode_switch": "blink sequence, 0.3 second transition", "recording": "2K continuous, 1TB onboard", "cosmetic_detectability": "presents as standard fashion ocular on biometric scan", "zoom": "1x–8x optical"}
side_effects: Mode-switch blink sequence occasionally triggers during REM sleep, causing users to wake in tactical mode
Peripheral motion prediction creates hyperawareness in crowded social settings that users describe as exhausting
The obsidian aesthetic blocks the user's own eye-contact social cues, creating subtle but persistent interpersonal distance
Dual-processor thermal load causes mild orbital warmth perceptible to close physical contact
cultural_context: The Obsidian Vigil exists in a deliberate legal gray zone that Vesper navigates through aggressive private-client agreements and strategic ambiguity about what exactly the tactical suite constitutes under Meridian law. Among the Spire's threat-aware elite, wearing a pair is a statement: you take your own safety seriously enough to hide that you're taking it seriously, which is the most Spire thing imaginable.
known_users: Tier 4–5 executives and VIPs with genuine personal threat profiles
High-profile entertainers with dedicated security concerns
Spire-level organized crime leadership maintaining social legitimacy
Private security consultants embedded in civilian social contexts
Wealthy individuals who have survived at least one assassination attempt
story_hooks: A Vesper private clinic appointment list has leaked, and every name on it is now a target for someone who wants to know which Spire elite are running hidden tactical hardware
A socialite's Obsidian Vigil tactical logs recorded a conversation at a Canopy party that neither party was supposed to have — the recording is now the most valuable object in the city

Vesper is quietly recalling a specific production batch of Vigil units, and they're not saying why — the owners of that batch are being contacted by a very different kind of representative than a Vesper service technician
